# std::printf

Module file: `stdlib/std/printf.mla`

MLang-facing wrappers over C-style output that accept preformatted strings.

### API
- `printf(s: str8) -> void`
- `eprintf(s: str8) -> void`
- `fprintf(fd: i32, s: str8) -> void`
